english.note: Use this for an emotion or situation having a strong effect on someone, often with 好大 or 深深噉.

exampleSentences.english: That news has a strong grip on me, so I can't sleep all night.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我畀呢單新聞影響好大，成晚都瞓唔着。
